summary: Every course must be letter graded. You take the foundation courses (ARTHIST 1A or 1B, and FILMEDIA 4 and 6 for 5 units each), FILMEDIA 101 and 102 (102 is also Writing in the Major) and two film history courses for at least 4 units each, one studio course, the FILMEDIA 290 capstone, and five subplan electives of at least 4 units, for 61 units. Culture and Criticism allows at most one FILMPROD course among its five, and Screenwriting needs at least one FILMEDIA course among its five. Your advisor approves your subplan electives and checks the library orientation, an Art History elective used in place of ARTHIST 1A or 1B, and courses taken away from Stanford (at most two). Honors adds 10 units of FILMEDIA 297, the 3.5 GPA overall and in the major, and an approved proposal and thesis.
